Drug Guide & Clinical Deep-Dive
Every condition shows its Golden Sign, best treatment, do’s/don’ts and nursing care. Open Library → Drug Guide for 85 drug monographs (each with a golden point), an interaction checker, dose calculators and emergency protocols. Each drug also shows brand names, mechanism, pharmacokinetics, US-label doses and side-effect management, and the Practice tab has pharmacology flashcards and quizzes. Golden Signs are in Flashcards too.
